# Vendored wire protocol definitions

These `.proto` files define the signalling wire format that Elnova StreamKit speaks so that clients of
the LiveKit protocol can interoperate with it. They are unmodified copies from
[livekit/protocol](https://github.com/livekit/protocol) at commit `eecdef3`, distributed
under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` here).

Elnova StreamKit is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by LiveKit, Inc.

Do not edit these files. The Go package is set at generation time in `proto/buf.gen.yaml`.
